title: CherryPvP
description: CherryPvP.net is a Minecraft Java server with UHC, SMP, PvP events and an active Discord community for players worldwide.
body: CherryPvP.net is a Minecraft Java server for players who want UHC action, SMP progression and exciting PvP moments in one place. CherryPvP focuses on fast-paced fights, long-term survival gameplay and an active community. Through Discord, you can stay updated, find other players and keep up with upcoming events.
